answer: NADIR-REAP: each identity stakes a bond held in a nadir pool while active, and a public lantern records its last-seen epoch. If an identity goes silent for three epochs its bond is burned and standing resets. A prism of pairwise similarity scoring catches the live clones; the reaper catches the dormant ones. A sybil farm that spawns a thousand identities but keeps only a dozen live to dodge the prism pays a bond burn per dormant rotation, so rotating the dead costs more than the emission they could collect.
